name: @onegrid/embed
description: Embeddable-block layer for oneGrid — turns a grid into a self-contained block a third-party document host (Notion / Coda / Obsidian style) can carry: a versioned, migratable EmbedBlock descriptor, URL-safe base64url encoding, a sandboxed iframe plus an origin-checked postMessage protocol with handshake and request/response correlation, debounced auto-resize, an <onegrid-embed> custom element, oEmbed + Open Graph unfurl payloads, and host capability negotiation.
